persons.name: Ratnamuni
persons.evidence: thama svādhyāya nīyītīna cocakā juro, śrī rahnamunī vajrācājena thva saphurī sīdhayakā juro

purpose: thama svādhyāya nīyītīna (for one's own recitation/study)
notes: The scribe Ratnamuni Vajrācārya copied the manuscript for his own study (thama svādhyāya nīyītīna) while residing at the mansion/estate of Jamarāma (jamarāmayā mahālasa). The Newari date specifies 'ṣunusa' (on the 6th day) of the dark fortnight.
